intentions.title: Collapse Barkpark onboarding into a single `bp setup` entry point covering connect, cloud login, local dev, remote deploy, and cloud provisioning
intentions.evidence: setup.go's SetupPlan/Target enum (connect|cloud|local|deploy|provision) and Execute dispatch table; wizard.go's stageTarget picker offering all five as one linear flow; deploy.sh + caddy.go + provision.go implement the heavier targets behind the same plan shape.

intentions.title: Make every setup path dry-runnable and JSON-renderable before it does anything real
intentions.evidence: plan.go's Plan/RenderHuman split; BuildPlan in setup.go builds the same Plan struct the human dry-run and the --json dry-run both render from ('the two never drift'); connect.go's executeConnect explicitly skips all network I/O under opts.DryRun and prints exactly what it would save.

intentions.title: Never let a public/anonymous-resolving token get silently persisted as a working credential
intentions.evidence: connect.go: /v1/capabilities is public so an invalid token never 401s — executeConnect explicitly refuses to save when plan.Token != "" but the probed tier resolves to none/anonymous, citing the same hint as the 401 path.

intentions.title: Prove a freshly deployed/provisioned Barkpark server is genuinely ready, not just reachable, before declaring go-live
intentions.evidence: healthgate.go's HealthGate runs 7 checks (capabilities, /studio, LiveView websocket non-403, TLS, Postgres-through-API, agent status, backup schedule) plus an optional cloud-sites check; explicitly targets the check_origin/PHX_HOST websocket-403 footgun documented as a recurring incident (docs/ops/studio-nav-bug-2026-04-19.md).

intentions.title: Let a self-hosting user go from bare VPS to a running, TLS-terminated Barkpark with one script/command, on either ARM64 or x86_64
intentions.evidence: assets/deploy.sh installs Postgres, ASDF/Erlang/Elixir, Go, clones the repo, and requires a public DOMAIN (not an IP) specifically to avoid the check_origin 403 trap; caddy.go's CaddyOpts generates the ACME/Caddyfile + PHX_HOST/PHX_SCHEME env wiring for exactly one managed subdomain.

intentions.title: Chain cloud host provisioning straight into deploy so 'create a server' and 'install Barkpark on it' are one guided action, never a silent partial state
intentions.evidence: provision.go's executeProvision: always previews the exact provider CLI commands first; real creation requires opts.Confirm AND a present CLI+credential; on success it captures the new IP and 'CHAINS into the DEPLOY target' rather than leaving a provisioned-but-unconfigured host.

intentions.title: Ship an interactive terminal wizard that reuses the CLI's own semantic color roles, so setup feels like the rest of the TUI rather than a bolted-on installer
intentions.evidence: wizard.go's Bubble Tea model with target-select, server pick-list, per-target inputs, profile (clean vs demo seed), plugin multi-select, and confirm stages; styling pulled through internal/semrole (roleColor for ok/warn) rather than hardcoded colors, panicking on unknown roles to keep the vocabulary honest.

intentions.title: Keep the setup package import-clean of both the CLI's config storage and the cloud control-plane client
intentions.evidence: setup.go doc comment: 'deliberately decoupled from the cli package's config storage to avoid an import cycle'; ConfigStore/CloudLoginFunc/WizardFunc are all injected hooks (Options.Store, Options.CloudLogin, Options.Wizard) so setup never imports cli or cloudclient directly.
